item.title: [Exclusive] Jang Dong-hyuk Returns to ‘Protest Site’ Just One Day After Discharge: “My Heart Feels Uncomfortable” ([단독] 장동혁, 퇴원 하루 만에 또 ‘올공’…“마음 불편해서”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, the leader of the People Power Party, who was hospitalized on the 18th and discharged on the 24th, visited the ‘vote counting station blockade protest’ site again on the 25th, just one day after his discharge. (지난 18일 입원했다가 24일 퇴원한 장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 퇴원 하루 만인 25일 ‘개표소 봉쇄 시위’ 현장을 다시 찾았다.)

That evening, Jang appeared in front of the Seoul Olympic Park Handball Stadium, where the protest was taking place, wearing a white cap and a black mask. The cap had the words ‘Freedom is not free’ written on it. (장 대표는 이날 저녁 흰색 모자를 쓰고 검은색 마스크를 착용한 채 시위가 열리고 있는 서울 올림픽공원 핸드볼경기장 앞에 모습을 드러냈다. 모자에는 ‘프리덤 이즈 낫 프리’(Freedom is not free·자유는 공짜가 아니다)라고 적혀 있었다.)

Jang shook hands with protest participants who recognized him and had brief conversations with YouTubers. When one YouTuber asked about his health condition, Jang said, “I haven’t fully recovered yet, but citizens are fighting even in the rain. My heart was too uncomfortable to just sit still, so I came out again today.” (장 대표는 자신을 알아본 시위 참가자들과 악수를 하고 유튜버들과 짧은 대화도 나눴다. 한 유튜버가 건강 상태를 묻자 장 대표는 “아직 다 회복은 안 됐는데 시민들이 비 오는 날에도 싸우고 계시지 않나. 가만히 있기가 마음이 너무 불편해서 오늘도 나와봤다”고 말했다.)

When the YouTuber expressed concern about the deployment of state force, Jang replied, “The People Power Party will do its best to ensure such things don’t happen as much as possible, and as the party leader, I will actively look into it.” In response to the chant “Fighting, Representative Jang Dong-hyuk!” Jang clenched his fist and answered, “Fighting!” (이 유튜버가 공권력 투입을 우려하자 장 대표는 “최대한 그런 일들이 발생하지 않도록 국민의힘에서 챙겨보고 당대표로서 적극 챙겨보도록 하겠다”고 답했다. “장동혁 대표님 파이팅입니다”라는 말에 장 대표는 주먹을 쥐고 “파이팅”이라고 화답했다.)

Another YouTuber asked Jang, “I wonder if you will push through to the end the citizens’ call at Olympic Park for ‘re-election of fraudulent elections, same-day voting, and hand counting.” Jang responded, “Even while hospitalized, the shouts of citizens crying out for ‘re-election of fraudulent elections, same-day voting, and hand counting’ kept echoing in my ears. I pondered how I could become a force to continue this and how to turn it into a result.” He added, “As a politician within the established system, I believe my role is to push for a special investigation and re-election, and reform the National Election Commission’s election system.” (또 다른 유튜버는 장 대표에게 “시민들이 올림픽공원에서 외치는 ‘부정선거 재선거 당일투표 수개표’를 끝까지 관철해 주시는 건지 궁금하다”고 물었다. 그러자 장 대표는 “입원해 있으면서도 ‘부정선거 재선거 당일투표 수개표’를 외치는 시민들의 함성이 계속 귀에 맴돌아서 어떻게 이걸 계속 이어 나가는 힘이 되어드릴 수 있을까 그리고 이걸 어떻게 결과로 만들 수 있을까 고민했다”고 말했다. 그러면서 “저는 제도권 안에 있는 정치인이니까 특검과 재선거를 관철하고 선관위 선거 제도를 개혁하고 그게 저희들이 결국 해야 할 역할이라고 생각한다”고 덧붙였다.)

In addition, when a man shouted, “Realize party member sovereignty!” Jang replied, “Yes, I will do so. I will go all the way with the party members.” (이밖에 한 남성이 “당원주권주의를 실현해 달라”고 외치자 장 대표는 “네 그렇게 하겠습니다. 당원과 함께 끝까지 가겠다”고 말하기도 했다.)

Jang, facing pressure to resign within the party, has visited Olympic Park multiple times since the ballot shortage incident in the June 3 local elections. On the 9th, Jang participated in the protest holding a placard reading ‘Re-election of fraudulent elections, same-day voting, and hand counting.’ On the 13th, he wrote phrases for protest participants, such as “Freedom for a cup of coffee! Freedom to shout about fraudulent elections. Jang Dong-hyuk at Olympic Park.” On the 16th, he mediated discussions between employees of sports organizations under the Korean Sport & Olympic Committee, who were trying to enter an office inside the Handball Stadium, and the protesters. However, a woman in her 30s, known as the ‘Stars and Stripes woman,’ blocked the entrance until the end, ultimately thwarting the entry into the office. (당내 사퇴 압박을 받고 있는 장 대표는 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 이후 여러 차례 올림픽공원을 찾았다. 지난 9일 ‘부정선거 재선거 당일투표 수개표’라고 적힌 손팻말을 들고 시위에 참석했던 장 대표는 지난 13일 “커피 한 잔의 자유! 부정선거를 외칠 자유. 올공에서 장동혁” 등의 글귀를 시위 참가자들에게 써주기도 했다. 지난 16일에는 핸드볼경기장 안에 있는 사무실에 진입하려는 대한체육회 산하 종목단체 직원들과 시위대 간 협의를 중재하기도 했는데 이른바 ‘성조기 여성’으로 불리는 30대 여성이 마지막까지 출입구를 막아 사무실 진입은 끝내 무산된 바 있다.)

On the day of his discharge, Jang held a press conference at the National Assembly, stating, “The party leader’s position is a matter for party members to decide,” repeatedly dismissing calls for his resignation. Regarding the ‘vote counting station blockade protest,’ he argued, “Many young people and citizens are genuinely calling for the restoration of their voting rights, but slogans and flags driven by the political aims of certain forces are weakening the momentum of resistance and actually hindering the unity of citizens.” (장 대표는 퇴원 당일 국회에서 기자회견을 열어 “당대표의 거취는 당원들이 결정할 문제”라며 사퇴 요구를 거듭 일축했다. ‘개표소 봉쇄 시위’와 관련해서는 “많은 청년과 시민들이 순수하게 참정권 회복을 외치고 있는데, 특정 세력의 정치적 목적을 품은 구호와 깃발이 저항 동력을 떨어뜨리고 시민 결집을 오히려 방해하고 있다”고 주장하기도 했다.)

Reporter Lee Yoo-jin yjlee@hani.co.kr (이유진 기자 yjlee@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Yong-beom: "The Numbers Are So Big They'll Feel Unfamiliar"… Hints at Record-Breaking Investment Announcement (김용범 “숫자 너무 커 낯설 것”…역대급 투자 발표 예고)
item.description:
With the Cheong Wa Dae set to hold the "Three Mega Projects for Korea's Great Leap Forward National Briefing" on the 29th to unveil investment plans for innovative projects by the government and companies, Cheong Wa Dae Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom said, "The numbers that come out at the briefing will feel unfamiliar," hinting at a 'record-breaking scale of investment.' (오는 29일 청와대가 ‘대한민국 대도약 3대 메가프로젝트 국민보고회’를 열어 정부와 기업들의 혁신사업 투자 계획을 발표하는 가운데, 김용범 청와대 정책실장은 “보고회에 나오는 숫자들이 낯설 것”이라며 ‘역대급 투자 규모’를 예고했다.)

Appearing on the YouTube channel "Kim Ou-joon's Humility is Hard News Factory" on the morning of the 26th, Director Kim stated, "It will be an opportunity to explain programs created through the efforts of the government and companies in three sectors. We will reveal specific investment plans," adding, "The numbers (are so large) that debates will intensify, starting with 'Is this for real?'" (김 실장은 26일 오전 ‘김어준의 겸손은힘들다 뉴스공장’ 유튜브에 나와 “3대 분야에서 정부와 기업들의 노력으로 만든 프로그램을 설명하는 자리가 될 것이다. 구체적인 투자 계획을 밝힐 것”이라며 “숫자가 (커서) ‘진짜냐’부터 시작해 논쟁이 격화될 것”이라고 말했다.)

Regarding the controversy that the government is forcing large-scale semiconductor facility investments in the Honam region, Director Kim said, "These are world-class top two companies, (the government) can't just squeeze them," and noted, "Each company will also explain well why such large numbers are coming out." He added, "Starting from that day, we plan to hold relay briefings by region." (김 실장은 정부가 호남지역에 대규모 반도체 설비 투자를 강요한다는 논란에 대해 “세계 1,2위 기업 수준인데 (정부가) 쥐어짠다고 되는 게 아니다”라며 “왜 그렇게 큰 숫자가 나오는지 각 기업들도 잘 설명할 것”이라고 말했다. 또 “이날을 시작으로 지역별 릴레이 설명회도 가질 계획”이라고 덧붙였다.)

The previous day, President Yoon reportedly said at a senior secretaries' meeting, "The multipolarization of groundbreaking strategic industries, expanding large-scale investments in advanced core industries to Yeongnam, Chungcheong, Gangwon, Jeju, and Honam, is essential," and "We will soon report the specific blueprint to the people." (전날 이 대통령은 수석보좌관회의에서 “첨단핵심산업에 대한 대규모 투자를 영남이나 충청, 강원, 제주, 호남으로 확대하는 획기적 전략 산업 다극화가 필수적”이라며 “구체적 청사진을 곧 국민께 보고드릴 예정”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Go Gyeong-ju goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Jong Un tests weapons for strike on South on June 25 anniversary…“Must enhance lethal attack posture” (김정은, 6·25 맞아 대남 타격용 무기 시험…“치명적 공격태세 높여야”)
item.description:
North Korean leader Kim Jong Un oversaw tests of new multiple rocket launchers and missiles targeting key facilities in the South on June 25, marking the anniversary of the outbreak of the Korean War. <<> The Korean Central News Agency reported on the 26th that Kim observed important weapons tests organized by defense science research institutes the previous day, under a “plan for the modernization of artillery and missile forces” aimed at achieving the five-year national defense development goals. The agency stated that the tests “analyzed and evaluated the combat characteristics of the updated 240mm 24-barrel multiple rocket launcher system, the warhead power of tactical ballistic missiles for special missions, and the accuracy of extended-range 155mm self-propelled howitzer shells.” It introduced the updated 24-barrel rocket launcher system as “an improved corps-level firepower system with all elements of the fire control system automated and incorporating a autonomous precision guidance system, with a range increased to 90 km.” <<> It further reported that the special mission warhead for tactical ballistic missiles “aims at the lethal destruction of key targets including enemy airfields, ports, and power facilities.” While the specific strike method of the special warhead was not disclosed, speculation suggests it could be a cluster munition or penetrating warhead capable of striking a relatively wide area. A test was also conducted of a 65 km range-extended shell for 155mm self-propelled howitzers. The tests on this day appeared to focus on improving the performance of strike assets within range of South Korea. <<> Among these, the test of the 65 km range-extended shell for 155mm self-propelled howitzers is believed to have involved the “North Korean version of the K9” new self-propelled howitzer, whose production status Kim inspected during a visit to an “important munitions industrial enterprise” in May. If North Korea’s claim of developing a range of over 60 km is true, this could place Seoul within striking distance. <<> Meanwhile, the South Korean military has completed development of an extended-range 155mm shell for the K9 self-propelled howitzer, increasing its range from 41 km to over 60 km, and began mass production in 2024. South Korea is also pursuing a project to secure a ballistic correction fuze with guidance capabilities to improve the accuracy of the developed extended-range 155mm shell. <<> North Korean media released photos showing Kim, accompanied by senior military officials, inspecting the weapons systems arrayed along the coast. Images also captured the shells and missiles launching from self-propelled howitzers and transporter erector launchers, creating clouds of dust and massive flames from multiple angles. <<> Kim expressed satisfaction with the test results, evaluating that “today’s tests of the division and corps-level firepower systems provide an opportunity to prove and be confident in the significant technological progress made in realizing our Party’s policy on building military forces regarding changes in the firepower posture on the southern border, and the three major principles of automation, long-range capability, and ultra-precision.” He further argued for the legitimacy of military reinforcement, stating, “Today’s international situation makes it unnecessary to add any rhetorical explanation as to why the work of strengthening defense capabilities has become an indispensable top national strategic task.” <<> Kim mentioned the need to prioritize the development of the Army’s artillery and missile forces and emphasized the defense development tasks to be achieved during the five-year plan period. He said, “Our Party’s self-defensive defense policy is not merely about enhancing defensive functions based on defensive means, but a policy to raise a lethal and destructive attack posture so that no enemy can stand against us. This is what we mean by the defensive concept in military construction and military action practice.” He added, “Keeping the enemy in constant anxiety and fear itself is an important aspect of executing war deterrence. We will make the enemy aware that within the shortest possible time, all of our military’s long-range strike means will be replaced with updated equipment.” He reiterated, “Building the most powerful artillery force is our Party’s unwavering will and strategic policy.” <<> Military authorities typically notify the media when North Korea fires ballistic missiles, but they did not announce the rocket launcher launches from the previous day. A Joint Chiefs of Staff official explained, “We detected about 10 rounds, including rocket launcher fire, and the detailed specifications are currently under close analysis.” <<> Senior Reporter Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (김정은 북한 국무위원장이 6·25 전쟁 발발일을 맞아 25일 남 쪽의 주요 시설 타격을 목적으로 하는 신형 방사포와 미사일 등의 무기 시험을 참관했다.)

item.title: President Lee's Approval Rating at 51%, Lowest Since Taking Office… Negative Ratings Exceed 40% for First Time (이 대통령 지지율 51% ‘취임 뒤 최저’…부정평가 40% 처음 넘어)
item.description:
A poll released on the 26th showed that positive evaluations of President Lee Jae-myung's state affairs management stood at 51%, the lowest since his inauguration. (이재명 대통령의 국정운영에 대한 긍정평가가 51%로 취임 이후 최저치를 기록했다는 여론조사 결과가 26일 나왔다.)

According to a survey conducted by Gallup Korea from the 23rd to the 25th among 1,000 voters aged 18 and over nationwide (with a sampling error of ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level, using phone interviews with virtual mobile numbers), the positive evaluation of the president's job performance was 51%, while the negative evaluation was 41%. Compared to the survey two weeks ago (conducted from the 9th to the 11th), the positive rating dropped by 6 percentage points, and the negative rating rose by 6 percentage points. The positive evaluation is the lowest since taking office, and the negative evaluation exceeded 40% for the first time since his inauguration. <<> Reasons cited for the negative evaluation included the economy, people's livelihoods, and the high exchange rate (15%), 'poor management, election fraud, and issues with the election commission' (10%), and real estate policy (10%). The issue of poor management, election fraud, and the election commission, which was the top reason for negative ratings two weeks ago, fell to second place, while the 'economy, people's livelihoods, and high exchange rate' rose to the top. For positive evaluations, reasons included diplomacy (24%), the economy and people's livelihoods (15%), and doing well overall (8%). <<> In terms of party support, the Democratic Party of Korea remained unchanged from two weeks ago at 41%. The People Power Party recorded 27% this week, down from 29% two weeks ago. Undecided voters accounted for 23%. <<> Regarding the status of People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk, 48% of respondents said he 'should resign,' while 28% said he 'should remain as leader.' Among supporters of the People Power Party, 49% said he should remain as leader, while 39% said he should resign. For more details, refer to the website of the Central Election Public Opinion Review Committee. <<> Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr (한국갤럽이 지난 23∼25일 전국 만 18살 이상 유권자 1000명을 대상으로 실시한 여론조사(표본오차 95% 신뢰 수준에서 ±3.1%포인트, 휴대전화 가상번호 전화 인터뷰)에서, 이 대통령 직무수행에 대한 긍정평가는 51%, 부정평가는 41%였다. 2주 전(지난 9∼11일) 조사에 견주면 긍정평가는 6% 포인트 떨어졌고, 부정평가는 6%포인트 올랐다. 긍정 평가는 취임 후 최저치고, 부정 평가는 취임 이후 처음으로 40%를 넘었다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok 45%, Jeong Cheong-rae 24%, Song Young-gil 15%… Democratic Party Supporters' Preference for Party Leader [Gallup] (김민석 45%, 정청래 24%, 송영길 15%…민주 지지층 당 대표 선호도 [갤럽])
item.description:
A poll released on the 26th showed that Prime Minister Kim Min-seok is ahead of former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae in candidate preference for the August 17th Democratic Party of Korea national convention party leadership race. (8·17 더불어민주당 전당대회 당대표 인물 선호도에서 김민석 국무총리가 정청래 전 대표를 앞섰다는 여론조사 결과가 26일 나왔다.)

In a survey conducted by Gallup Korea from the 23rd to the 25th on 1,000 voters aged 18 and older nationwide (with a margin of error of ±3.1% points at a 95% confidence level, via mobile phone virtual number phone interviews), respondents were asked, 'Among the three figures mentioned as potential candidates in the upcoming Democratic Party leadership primary in August, who do you think would be best as party leader?' The results showed Prime Minister Kim at 26%, former Representative Jeong at 19%, and lawmaker Song Young-gil at 13%. A total of 41% withheld their opinion. (한국갤럽이 지난 23~25일 전국 만 18살 이상 유권자 1000명을 대상으로 실시한 여론조사(표본오차는 95% 신뢰 수준에서 ±3.1%포인트, 휴대전화 가상번호 전화 인터뷰)에서 ‘8월 예정된 더불어민주당 대표 경선 출마가 거론되는 3인 중 누가 당대표가 되는 것이 가장 좋다고 보는지’ 물은 결과, 김민석 총리는 26%, 정청래 전 대표는 19%, 송영길 의원은 13%로 나타났다. 41%는 의견을 유보했다.)

Among Democratic Party supporters (409 people, margin of error ±5% points), the results were Prime Minister Kim at 45%, former Representative Jeong at 24%, and lawmaker Song at 15%. A total of 15% withheld their opinion. (민주당 지지층을 대상으로 한 조사(409명, 표본오차 ±5%포인트)에서는 김 총리 45%, 정 전 대표 24%, 송 의원 15% 순으로 나타났다. 15%는 의견을 유보했다.)

The Democratic Party's national convention will reflect a 70% party member vote (including the first application of a one-person-one-vote system for eligible party members, including delegates) and a 30% general public opinion poll. (민주당 전대는 당원 투표 70%(대의원 포함 권리당원 1인 1표제 첫 적용), 일반 국민 여론조사 30% 비율로 반영해 진행된다.)

For more details, refer to the website of the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission. (자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의의원회 누리집을 보면 된다.)

item.title: Han Byung-do on Government's Stance to Abolish Supplementary Investigation Authority: “Begin Reviewing Amendments to the Criminal Procedure Act” (정부 ‘보완수사권 폐지’ 입장에 한병도 “형소법 개정 내용 검토 착수”)
item.description:
Han Byung-do, acting leader and floor leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 26th, “Amending the Criminal Procedure Act, the final step in prosecutorial reform, is an urgent task,” and “We will begin reviewing the contents of the amendments to the Criminal Procedure Act. As soon as the formation of (the standing committees for the second half of the 22nd National Assembly) is completed, we will immediately start the amendment process.” (한병도 더불어민주당 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표가 26일 “검찰개혁 마지막 단추인 형사소송법 개정은 초읽기 과제”라며 “형사소송법 개정 내용 검토에 착수하겠다. (22대 국회 후반기 상임위원회) 원 구성이 마무리되는 즉시 개정 절차에 곧바로 돌입하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

During the party's Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly that day, Floor Leader Han stated, “With the abolition of the Prosecutor's Office and the launch of the Public Prosecution Service and the Serious Crimes Investigation Office approaching in October this year, the answer to when the revision of the Criminal Procedure Act will begin is clear.” This indicates that discussions on legal amendments regarding whether to grant supplementary investigation authority to public prosecutors, and if so, to what extent, will commence immediately. (한 원내대표는 이날 국회에서 열린 당 최고위원회의에서 “검찰청 폐지와 공소청·중수청(중대범죄수사청) 출범이 올해 10월로 다가온 만큼, 형사소송법 개정이 언제 시작되느냐는 질문에 대한 답은 분명하다”며 이렇게 말했다. 공소청 검사에게 보완수사권을 줄지, 준다면 어느 정도까지 허용할지에 대한 법 개정 논의를 곧바로 시작하겠다는 것이다.)

Floor Leader Han also set the timing for negotiations on forming standing committees for the second half of the 22nd National Assembly as “today.” He said, “Nearly a month has passed since the second half of the National Assembly opened, but not a single one of the 18 standing committees is operational,” and added, “The Democratic Party has requested (National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik) that if the People Power Party does not submit its list by noon today, the Speaker should immediately proceed with the procedures under the National Assembly Act to directly appoint committee members. The Democratic Party will unilaterally push forward with forming the standing committees in accordance with National Assembly procedures.” (한 원내대표는 22대 국회 후반기 상임위 구성 협상 시점도 “오늘”로 못 박았다. 그는 “후반기 국회가 문을 연 지 한 달이 다 되도록 18개 상임위 가운데 단 하나도 가동하지 못하고 있다”며 “민주당은 (조정식 국회의장에게) 국민의힘이 오늘 정오까지 명단을 제출하지 않는다면 국회의장께서 직접 위원을 선임하는 국회법 절차에 돌입해 달라고 요청했다. 민주당은 국회법 절차에 따라 상임위를 단독 강행하겠다”고 말했다.)

Earlier, on the 24th, Speaker Woo had urged both ruling and opposition parties to submit their lists of members for the second-half standing committees by noon that day, warning, “If no list is submitted by then, the Speaker will have no choice but to consider procedures for directly appointing members.” With the ruling and opposition parties still at odds over the chairmanship of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, the Democratic Party had previously announced that if negotiations were not concluded by that day, it would take all 18 standing committee chair positions. (앞서 지난 24일 조 의장은 여야에 이날 정오까지 후반기 상임위원 명단을 제출하도록 하고, 이때까지 “명단 제출이 없으면 의장으로선 직접 위원을 선임하는 절차를 고민하지 않을 수 없다”고 경고한 바 있다. 국회 법제사법위원장 자리를 놓고 여야의 입장차가 여전한 가운데, 민주당은 이날까지 협상이 되지 않으면 18개 상임위원장 자리를 모두 가져오겠다고 밝힌 바 있다.)

Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "Call for resignation is a party-damaging act... It's time to take delayed disciplinary action" (장동혁 “사퇴 요구는 해당행위…미뤄둔 징계 할 때 됐다”)
item.description:
People Power Party (PPP) leader Jang Dong-hyuk has openly mentioned taking disciplinary measures against the pro-Han (Han Dong-hoon) faction that called for his resignation as party leader. (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 ‘대표직 사퇴’를 요구한 친한(한동훈)계를 향한 징계 조치를 본격 거론했다.)

In an appearance on Maeil Shinmun's YouTube channel on the 26th, Jang stated, "The party is not in a normal state right now," and "It's time to address the disciplinary actions that were postponed until after the local elections." The party's Ethics Committee has received disciplinary requests against pro-Han lawmakers Bae Hyun-jin and Park Jung-hoon, Supreme Council member Woo Jae-joon, and lawmakers belonging to the Alternatives and Future group. The grounds for the disciplinary requests are that they supported independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon during the local elections and called for the resignation of leader Jang. (장 대표는 26일 매일신문 유튜브에 출연해 “지금 당이 정상적 모습은 아니다”라며 “지방선거 이후로 미뤄놨던 징계조치에 대해 답을 할 때가 됐다”고 밝혔다. 현재 당 윤리위원회에는 친한계 배현진·박정훈 의원과 우재준 최고위원, 대안과미래 소속 의원들에 대한 징계요청서가 접수돼 있다. 지방선거 과정에서 한동훈 무소속 의원을 돕고, 장 대표 사퇴를 요구했다는 게 징계 요청 이유다.)

Jang said, "Under names like innovation, alternatives, and future, shaking the leadership without justification is something that must definitely be sorted out this time." When asked whether disciplinary action would also cover supporting candidates outside the party, he replied, "All matters for which disciplinary requests have been submitted need to be comprehensively reviewed." Regarding concerns that a significant number of incumbent lawmakers could be subject to discipline, he said, "This is not a matter of whether someone is an incumbent or not. Discipline is a matter of principles and standards, and it's not appropriate to apply different criteria when it comes to strengthening party discipline." (장 대표는 “혁신과 대안, 미래라는 이름으로 명분 없이 지도부를 흔드는 것에 대해 이번에 반드시 정리할 필요가 있다”고 말했다. 당 밖의 후보를 도운 것에 대한 징계도 포함되는지 묻는 말에 “징계 요청이 들어온 모든 사안을 전반적으로 검토할 필요가 있다”고 답했다. 현역 의원 상당수가 징계 대상에 해당할 수 있다는 우려에 대해 “현역인지 아닌지 따질 문제가 아니다. 징계는 원칙과 기준의 문제고, 당의 기강을 세워나가는 데 있어서 다른 잣대 들이대는 것 맞지 않는다”고 했다.)

Jang stated, "A disciplinary process is needed that thoroughly reviews procedural and substantive aspects to ensure that new controversies don't arise in court like last time." This refers to the situation where the PPP's Ethics Committee imposed heavy discipline on lawmaker Bae Hyun-jin and former Supreme Council member Kim Jong-hyuk, only for the court to accept a request for a temporary suspension of the effect, and Jang wants to prevent a recurrence. (장 대표는 “절차적으로 내용적으로 면밀하게 검토해서 지난번처럼 법원에서 새로운 논란이 생기지 않게 하는 징계 절차가 필요하다”고 말했다. 앞서 국민의힘 윤리위원회가 배현진 의원과 김종혁 전 최고위원에 대해 중징계를 내렸다가, 법원이 효력정지 가처분신청을 인용했던 상황이 반복되지 않게 하겠다는 것이다.)

Regarding the calls for his resignation, Jang argued, "It's blind" and "Too far removed from the sentiment of party members and the public." (장 대표는 자신을 향한 사퇴 요구에는 “맹목적”이라며 “당심·민심과 너무 동떨어진 말”이라고 주장했다.)

He strongly criticized, "The goal of those calling for a vote of confidence or my resignation is ultimately a power struggle within the party or protecting their own seats," adding, "I don't know what purpose they have in mind for politics. Are they doing politics with the attitude, 'It's okay if the PPP, the Republic of Korea, and conservative politics collapse. As long as my seat badge is on until the very moment of collapse, I'm fine'?" He said, "Attacking the party leader without properly understanding the sentiment of the party members makes things difficult for the party, and that itself is a party-damaging act." (그는 “재신임 투표나 사퇴를 요구하는 사람들의 목적은 결국 당내 권력싸움 아니면 배지를 지키기 위한 것”이라며 “그분들은 도대체 목적을 무엇에 두고 정치하는지 모르겠다. ‘국민의힘이, 대한민국이, 보수정치가 망해도 괜찮다. 망하는 순간까지 내 배지 하나만 끝까지 달려있으면 괜찮다’는 마음으로 정치하나”라고 강하게 비판했다. 그는 “당심도 제대로 알지 못하면서 당 대표를 공격하는 것은 당을 어렵게 만다는 것이고, 그 자체가 해당행위다”라고 했다.)

Jang stated, "Party members will be a source of strength," and "Moving toward the goal of being a party centered on party members is ultimately the way to properly build the party and maintain discipline." He added, "Changing the party's constitution is the very start of conservative reconstruction." (장 대표는 “당원들이 힘이 되어줄 것”이라며 “당원을 보고 당원 중심 정당으로 가겠다는 목표 아래서 움직이는 것이 결국 당을 제대로 세울 수 있고 기강을 잡을 수 있는 길”이라고 말했다. 이어 “당의 체질을 바꾸는 것이야말로 보수 재건의 시작”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: North Korean drone 'Yoon Seok-yeol Drone Command' restructured as Defense Drone Headquarters, stripped of operational functions (평양 무인기 ‘윤석열 드론사’, 작전 기능 뺀 국방드론본부로 개편)
item.description:
The Ministry of National Defense has decided to reorganize the Drone Operations Command (Drone Command) into the Defense Drone Headquarters, a policy organization that will oversee drone and counter-drone combat development, acquisition support, and the like, without engaging in direct operations. (국방부는 드론작전사령부(드론사)를는 작전을 하고 않고 드론·대드론 전투발전, 획득지원 등을 맡는 정책조직 성격의 국방드론본부로 개편하기로 했다.)

Minister of National Defense Ahn Kyu-baek announced this drone and counter-drone development policy during a briefing at the Ministry of National Defense building in Seoul on the 26th. (안규백 국방부 장관은 26일 서울 국방부 청사에서 브리핑을 하고 이런 내용을 담은 드론·대드론 발전 정책을 발표했다.)

The Drone Command, established in 2023 by the Yoon Seok-yeol administration as a response to North Korean drones violating the capital region's airspace in December 2022, faced criticism for not aligning with military organizational concepts. This was because, in modern warfare where drones are widely used and should be integrated into units at all levels to be used like rifles, a separate operations command solely for drone operations was created. Critics argued that following this logic, a rifle command should also be established. (윤석열 정부가 2022년 12월 북한 무인기 수도권 영공 침범에 대한 대응책으로 2023년 창설한 드론사는 군 편성 개념 등에 맞지 않는다는 지적을 받았다. 현대전에서 드론이 광범위하게 쓰이면서 각급 부대에 드론을 편제해 소총처럼 사용해야 하는데 드론작전만을 하는 작전사령부를 별도로 만들었기 때문이다. 드론사령부를 만드는 논리라면 소총사령부도 만들어야 한다는 비판도 나왔다.)

Despite such criticisms, the hastily formed Drone Command sparked controversy by being involved in the so-called 'Pyongyang drone' incident in October 2024. (이런 지적에도 급조된 드론사는 지난 2024년 10월 벌어진 이른바 ‘평양 무인기’ 사건을 벌여 논란이 됐다.)

The Ministry plans to reassign the Drone Command's operational functions to each branch of the military and transform the Defense Drone Headquarters into a specialized organization dedicated to concept development and requirements identification in the drone and counter-drone field, acquisition support in coordination with each branch, and collaboration with industries and various agencies. The Defense Drone Headquarters will be organized as a unit directly under the Ministry of National Defense, with a major general serving as its head. (국방부는 드론사의 작전 수행 기능은 각 군으로 조정하고 국방드론본부는 드론·대드론 분야 개념발전 및 소요발굴, 각 군과 연계한 획득지원, 산업계 및 다양한 기관과의 협력을 전담하는 전문 조직으로 바꾼다는 계획이다. 국방드론본부는 국방부 직속 부대로 편성되며 소장급이 본부장을 맡는다.)

The Ministry explained, "We will improve the current system where some drone capabilities are operated primarily around specific units, and develop each service branch to conduct integrated surveillance, reconnaissance, and strike operations," adding that the Army, Navy, Air Force, and Marine Corps will develop drone operation concepts and tactics suitable for their respective characteristics and missions. (국방부는 “현재 일부 드론 전력이 특정 부대 중심으로 운용되고 있는 체계를 개선해 각 군이 감시·정찰과 타격작전을 통합적으로 수행할 수 있도록 발전시켜 나가겠다”며 육·해·공군 및 해병대가 각각 특성과 임무에 적합한 드론 운용개념과 전술을 발전시키도록 하겠다고 설명했다.)

The Ministry also stated that it will swiftly pursue the fielding of Korean-made long-range loitering munitions for strategic strikes and neutralizing enemy air defense systems, in preparation for recent warfare trends. (국방부는 아울러 최근 전쟁 양상에 대비해 전략적 타격 및 적 방공망 무력화를 위한 한국형 장거리 자폭무인기 전력화를 신속히 추진하겠다고 밝혔다.)

This appears to be a concept similar to the 'Lucas,' a low-cost unmanned combat aerial system that the US reverse-engineered from Iranian Shahed drones and deployed in the US-Israel-Iran war. Alongside this, the Ministry announced plans to rapidly secure over 20,000 low-cost, expendable drones such as short-range reconnaissance drones and small loitering munitions, and concurrently develop next-generation drone capabilities like swarm drones with AI technology, to prepare for future battlefields. (미국·이스라엘-이란전쟁에서 미국이 이란제 샤헤드를 역설계해 실전 투입한 저비용 무인 전투 공격 체계 ‘루카스’와 비슷한 개념으로 보인다. 이와 함께 근거리정찰드론, 소형자폭드론 등 저가·소모성 드론을 2만 대 이상 신속 확보하고, 인공지능(AI) 기술을 적용한 군집드론 등 차세대 드론전력 확보도 병행해 미래 전장에 대비하겠다고 밝혔다.)

In the short term, the plan includes deploying counter-drone systems and small unmanned aircraft response systems in forward-deployed areas adjacent to the border, and fielding commercially available equipment with proven performance to front-line units next year. (단기적으로 전방에 접적 지역 대드론체계, 소형무인기 대응체계 등을 배치하고 성능이 입증된 상용장비를 내년에 일선 부대에 배치하겠다는 계획이다.)

It further stated, "In the mid-to-long term, we will develop and field directed-energy weapons such as lasers and high-power microwaves requiring advanced technology, while also securing various means early, including low-cost interceptor drones to respond to low-cost drone threats." (또 “중장기적으로는 고도의 기술력이 필요한 레이저, 고출력마이크로파와 같은 지향성 에너지 무기를 개발해 전력화하는 한편, 저가 드론위협에 대응하기 위한 저비용 요격드론 등 다양한 수단도 조기에 확보해 나가겠다”고 밝혔다.)

The Ministry announced plans to innovate the acquisition system, stating, "We will pursue legislation to secure advanced capabilities flexibly and rapidly." (국방부는 획득체계를 혁신하겠다며 “유연하고 신속한 첨단전력 확보를 위한 법 제정을 추진하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Specifically, the plan involves building a differentiated rapid drone acquisition system through methods such as demonstrating civilian technology in the military for quick adoption, or linking it with certification systems for introducing commercial drones for military use, and then fielding them. (구체적으로는 민간기술을 군에서 실증한 후 신속히 도입하거나, 상용드론을 군용으로 도입하기 위한 인증체계와 연계해 전력화하는 등의 방식으로 차별화된 드론 신속획득체계를 구축하겠다는 계획이다.)

Furthermore, the Ministry reaffirmed its policy to foster 500,000 'drone warriors' so that all service members can use drones like a 'second personal weapon.' To this end, the Ministry plans to introduce approximately 60,000 domestically produced commercial drones for training purposes. (아울러 모든 장병이 드론을 ‘제2의 개인화기’처럼 활용할 수 있도록 50만 드론전사를 양성하겠다는 방침도 재확인했다. 국방부는 이를 위해 국산 교육용 상용드론 6만여대를 도입할 예정이다)

Reporter Kwon Hyuk-chul nura@hani.co.kr (권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Koh’s Take: “Jeong Cheong-rae Claims to Be the ‘True Heir’ of Pro-Roh and Pro-Moon? Would They Even Acknowledge That?” (고민정 “정청래가 친노·친문 ‘적통’? 그분들이 인정하실까”)
item.description:
Koh Min-jeong, a lawmaker of the Democratic Party of Korea, commented on former Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae’s visit to former President Moon Jae-in at the Seoul International Book Fair on the 24th, saying, “No matter what it is, if an intention is obvious, there’s no emotion in it.” (고민정 더불어민주당 의원이 정청래 전 대표가 지난 24일 서울국제도서전에 참여한 문 전 대통령을 찾아가 만난 것과 관련해 “무엇이든지 간에 의도가 읽히면 감동은 없다”고 말했다.)

Koh, who served as spokesperson for the Cheong Wa Dae under the Moon Jae-in administration, appeared on YTN Radio’s “Jang Seong-cheol’s News Plaza” on the 26th and stated, “The perspective of most citizens and party members, I believe, would be similar,” adding this remark. (문재인 정부 청와대 대변인을 지낸 고 의원은 26일 와이티엔(YTN) 라디오 장성철의 뉴스명당에 출연해 “대부분의 국민이 보는 시선이나 당원들이 보는 시선은 저는 비슷할 거라 본다”며 이렇게 말했다.)

Koh said, “(The book fair) is an open space, isn’t it? It’s unavoidable. In the morning, articles (about Rep. Jeong’s visit) had already come out, and even before that, several reporters contacted me to confirm (former President Moon’s schedule).” (고 의원은 “(도서전이) 열린 공간이지 않나. 어찌할 수 없는 것인데, 오전에 이미 (정 대표가 간다고) 기사가 났고 기사가 나기 전에 몇몇 기자들이 저한테 (문 전 대통령 일정) 확인 요청을 해왔다”고 말했다.)

When asked by the host, “If you were still an aide by former President Moon’s side and were told that Rep. Jeong was coming, what advice would you give on whether to meet him?” Koh replied, “I would advise not meeting him,” adding, “In the current heated competition for party leadership, if you meet some and not others, it inevitably stirs controversy. There’s no reason to create misunderstandings unnecessarily.” (고 의원은 ‘지금도 문 전 대통령 옆에 계신 참모라면 정 전 대표가 온다는데 만나야 하는지 묻는다면 어떻게 하겠는가’ 묻는 진행자 질문에 “안 만나는 게 맞다(고 조언하겠다)”며 “지금 당권 경쟁이 이렇게 치열한 상황에서 누구는 만나고 누구는 안 만나고 그러면 다시 또 논란이 될 수밖에 없다. 굳이 오해를 만들 이유는 없다”고 말했다.)

Regarding Rep. Jeong’s emphasis on being the “true heir of the pro-Roh and pro-Moon factions,” Koh commented, “Isn’t that he emphasized because he wants it to be recognized?” adding, “For example, when former President Moon ran for election, did he say, ‘I am Roh Moo-hyun’s person’? Everyone already knows that, so he doesn’t need to say it.” (고 의원은 정 전 대표가 ‘친노·친문의 적통’을 강조하는 데 대해 “그게 읽히길 바라는 마음에서 강조하는 거잖나”라며 “예를 들어 문 전 대통령께서 선거를 나섰을 때 ‘나는 노무현의 사람이다’고 얘기하는가. 모두가 다 그렇게 알고 있기 때문에 굳이 하지 않아도 (되는 것)”이라고 했다.)

Koh continued, “Just because someone was part of a certain faction, does that make them the true heir? Would those who have passed away even acknowledge that?” She added, “The true legacy of the Democratic Party is to pursue politics for the so-called weak.” (이어 “어떤 계파에 서 있었다고 해서 그 사람이 적통이다? 하늘에 계신 그분들께서 그런 것들을 인정하실까”라고 했다. 고 의원은 “소위 약한 분들을 위한 정치를 하는 게 민주당의 적통”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Regarding the luncheon meeting between Democratic Party leader Lee Jae-myung and former President Moon scheduled for the first of next month, Koh said, “The party seems to have reached a point where the strife (related to the party leadership race) is so worrisome that it’s overshadowing every issue,” adding, “Ultimately, it seems that the two of them meeting might be intended to stabilize the current situation.” (고 의원은 새달 1일 이재명 대통령과 문 전 대통령이 오찬 회동을 하는 데 대해 “당이 너무 걱정스러울 정도로 그 (전당대회 경쟁 관련) 분란이 모든 이슈를 다 덮어버릴 지경까지 간 것 같다”며 “결국은 두 분이 좀 만나심으로 인해서 지금의 국면을 좀 안정시키고자 함이 아닐까 싶다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, Koh stated about her potential candidacy in the August party leadership election, “I am considering it.” Koh remarked, “I have many complaints about (Rep. Jeong’s past activities as party leader),” adding, “Pro-Lee and pro-Moon, these are meaningless distinctions. We need to be pro-people. Only then can we be chosen by the public.” (한편, 고 의원은 오는 8월 전당대회 당대표 선거 출마 여부에 대해 “고민하고 있다”고 했다. 고 의원은 “(정 전 대표의 과거 당 대표 활동에 대해) 불만이 많다”며 “친명과 친문, 이건 아무 의미가 없다. 우리는 친국민이 돼야 한다. 그래야 국민들에게 선택받을 수 있다”고 했다.)

Reporter Koh Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party Election Commission Reform TF: "Dissolve Election Commission via Constitutional Amendment... Change Name, Composition, and Subject to Audit" (민주 선관위개혁TF “개헌으로 선관위 해체…명칭·구성 바꾸고 감사 받게 하겠다”)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea's "Task Force (TF) for Reforming the National Election Commission to Protect Citizens' Political Rights" stated, "We will dissolve the election commission through a constitutional amendment." Specifically, they announced plans to change the election commission's name, make the chairperson a full-time position, and push for a constitutional amendment to allow the Board of Audit and Inspection to audit the election commission. (더불어민주당 ‘국민 참정권 수호를 위한 선거관리위원회 개혁 태스크포스(TF)’가 “헌법 개정을 통해 선관위를 해체하겠다”고 말했다. 구체적으로는 선관위의 이름을 바꾸고, 선관위원장을 상임직으로 하며, 감사원이 선관위를 감사할 수 있도록 개헌을 추진하겠다고 밝혔다.)

The Democratic Party's Election Commission Reform TF, in a meeting held at the National Assembly on the 26th, proposed concrete measures at the "level of dissolution" through a constitutional amendment, aiming to structurally reform various issues of the election commission exposed by the "June 3 local election ballot shortage incident." ( 민주당 선관위 개혁 티에프는 26일 국회에서 연 회의에서 ‘6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태’로 드러난 선관위의 여러 문제점을 구조적으로 개혁하겠다며, 개헌을 통한 ‘해체 수준’의 구체적인 방안을 제안했다.)

The TF first stated, "We will change the name and composition of the election commission." Changing the name is intended to fundamentally dissolve the election commission, which has become a target of public distrust, and make a fresh start. Rep. Park Sang-hyuk, a member of the TF, said, "It should not be a simple secretariat focused on 'election management,' but should have a name and status that aligns with the fundamental purpose of 'protecting citizens' political rights.'" ( 티에프는 먼저 “선관위의 명칭과 구성 방식을 변경하겠다”고 했다. 이름을 바꾸는 건 국민적 불신의 대상이 된 선관위를 근본적으로 해체하고 새 출발을 하는 의미로, 티에프 소속 박상혁 의원은 “‘선거 관리’라는 단순한 사무 중심이 아니라 ‘국민의 참정권 보호’라는 근본 취지에 맞는 명칭과 위상이 돼야 한다”고 했다. )

Additionally, the TF stated, "Even before a constitutional amendment, we will strengthen accountability by making the (National) Election Commission chairperson a full-time position and expanding the number of standing commissioners." This involves converting the current practice of a Supreme Court justice serving part-time as the National Election Commission chairperson into a full-time role and increasing the current single standing commissioner to three, each responsible for election and voting management, investigation and enforcement, and organizational operations, to ensure that "internal management and oversight functions operate effectively." ( 또 티에프는 “헌법 개정 전이라도 (중앙)선관위원장 상임화와 상임위원 확대를 통해 책임성을 강화하겠다”고 했다. 현재 관행적으로 대법관이 비상근으로 겸직하고 있는 중앙선관위원장직을 상임화하고, 현재 1명인 선관위 상임위원을 3명으로 늘려 각각 선거·투표 관리, 조사·단속, 조직 운영 업무를 맡게 해 “내부 관리·감독 기능이 실질적으로 작동하도록 하겠다”는 것이다.)

The TF is also pursuing a constitutional amendment to allow the Board of Audit and Inspection to audit the election commission, which, as an independent body under the constitution, has not been subject to external audits. "This is to secure transparency in the overall finances and operations of the election commission, which has virtually been a sanctuary until now," they said. Additionally, they plan to "legislate the current internal audit committee of the election commission as an independent collegial decision-making body and mandate that audit results be reported to the National Assembly." ( 헌법상 독립기관으로 외부 감사를 받지 않아 온 선관위를 감사원이 감사할 수 있도록 개헌도 추진한다. “그동안 사실상 성역이었던 선관위의 재정·운영 전반에 투명성을 확보하겠다”는 것이다. 더불어 현 선관위 내부 감사위원회를 “독립적인 합의제 의결기구로 법제화하고, 감사 결과를 국회에 의무적으로 보고하도록 하겠다”고도 했다.)

The TF also announced the introduction of a National Assembly confirmation hearing for the Secretary-General of the election commission. ( 선관위 사무총장에 대한 국회 인사청문회도 도입하겠다고 했다. )

Rep. Song Ki-heon, head of the TF, said, "The Secretary-General has been the one effectively directing and supervising the entire election administration, instead of the part-time chairperson. Nevertheless, the Secretary-General has been appointed without any public verification process. By introducing a confirmation hearing for the Secretary-General, we will clearly establish responsibility for this (ballot shortage) incident and prevent recurrence by publicly verifying their expertise and moral integrity." ( 티에프 단장인 송기헌 의원은 “비상근인 위원장 대신 선거행정 전반을 실질적으로 지휘·감독해 온 건 사무총장이다. 그럼에도 사무총장은 어떠한 국민적 검증 절차도 없이 임명돼왔다”며 “이번 (투표용지 부족) 사태의 책임 소재를 분명히 하고, 향후 재발을 방지하기 위해 사무총장 인사청문회를 도입해 전문성과 도덕성을 공개적으로 검증하겠다”고 말했다.)

The TF also plans to establish a new "Election Management Evaluation Body" to analyze overall election management and mandate that this body produce an election management white paper after each election, which must be submitted to the National Assembly. ( 티에프는 또 선거 관리 전반을 분석하는 ‘선거관리평가기구’를 새로 만들고, 선거가 끝나면 이 기구에서 선거 관리 백서를 만들어 국회에 의무적으로 제출하도록 하겠다고 했다.)

The TF added, "We will continue to pursue specific legislation through discussions on parliamentary investigations and expert debates," and "We plan to push forward with the relevant bill amendments and constitutional amendment as swiftly as possible." ( 티에프는 “향후 국정조사 논의 결과 및 전문가 토론 과정을 통해 구체적인 입법을 지속해서 추진하겠다”며 “(관련) 법안 개정안하고 헌법 개정안은 가능한 한 신속하게 추진할 예정”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Kim Chae-un: cwk@hani.co.kr ( 김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "Three remaining ships in the Strait of Hormuz expected to depart by the weekend" (이 대통령 “호르무즈해협 남은 배 3척 주말 안에 빠져나올 것”)
item.description:
On the 26th, President Lee Jae-myung stated regarding the Strait of Hormuz, "There are five ships left," adding, "Aside from the Namuho, which is under repair, and one ship that has indicated its intention to remain due to cargo issues, the other three ships are expected to leave by the weekend." (이재명 대통령이 26일 호르무즈해협에 “남은 배는 5척”이라며 “수리 중인 나무호와 화물 문제로 잔류 의사를 밝힌 1척 등 2척을 제외한 3척도 주말 안에 빠져나올 것으로 예상된다”고 말했다.)

The president shared an article on X (formerly Twitter) that day titled 'Eight of our ships stranded in the Strait of Hormuz have additionally escaped.' President Lee said, "The fact that the detained merchant ships and crew were able to escape more swiftly and safely than any other country is largely and effectively due to the efforts of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the National Security Office, and the National Intelligence Service, who worked tirelessly through communication and cooperation, sacrificing sleep," and added, "I commend the hard work of public officials in the relevant ministries and ask for your encouragement as well." (이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 ‘호르무즈해협에 갇혔던 우리 선박 8척이 추가 탈출했다’는 기사를 공유했다. 이 대통령은 “어느 나라보다 신속하고 안전하게 억류 상선과 선원들이 탈출할 수 있었던 것은 밤잠을 설치며 소통 협력에 애쓴 외교부와 안보실, 국정원의 노력이 크고 주효했다”며 “관련 부처 공직자들의 노고를 치하하며, 여러분께도 격려를 부탁드린다”고 말했다.)

By Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee Nominates Park Mi-kyung as Chair of "Light Commission"... Commemorating Citizens Who Faced Martial Law Troops (이 대통령, ‘빛의 위원회’ 위원장 박미경 지명…계엄군 맞선 국민 기린다)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung nominated Park Mi-kyung, current chairperson and co-chair of the Gwangju Environmental Movement Federation, as the chair of the presidential Light Commission on the 26th. (이재명 대통령이 26일 대통령 직속 빛의 위원회 위원장에 박미경 현 광주환경운동연합 이사장 겸 공동의장을 지명했다.)

Senior Press Secretary Kang Yoo-jung of the Presidential Office announced this in a briefing, stating, "The Light Commission is a presidential committee established to honor the dedication and noble spirit of the citizens who defended the Constitution and democracy of the Republic of Korea through the Light Revolution, standing against armed soldiers during the December 3 emergency martial law." ( 강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 이날 “빛의 위원회는 12·3 비상계엄 당시 무장한 군인에 맞서 빛의 혁명으로 대한민국 헌법과 민주주의를 수호한 국민들의 헌신과 숭고한 정신을 기리기 위해 설치한 대통령 직속 위원회”라며 브리핑을 통해 이같이 밝혔다.)

The 'Light Commission' will consist of up to 35 members, including experts in constitutional and democratic affairs. The commission will be tasked with: establishing basic directions for the settlement and expansion of Korean-style citizen-participatory democracy (K-democracy) that defended the Constitution and democracy of the Republic of Korea; issuing and awarding Light certificates; and gathering opinions on designating a national commemorative day related to the Light Revolution. ( ‘빛의 위원회’는 헌법·민주주의 전문가 등 35명 이내로 구성된다. 위원회는 △대한민국 헌법과 민주주의를 수호한 한국형 시민참여 민주주의(K-민주주의)의 정착·확산 기본 방향 수립 △빛의 인증서 발급 및 수여 △빛의 혁명 관련 국가기념일 지정 의견수렴 등의 일을 하게 된다. )

Regarding Chairperson Park, it was stated, "She is a civic activist who has dedicated the past 30 years to the development of civil society and democracy, having served as co-chair of the Solidarity Council of Civil Society Organizations and national co-chair of the Environmental Movement Federation." It added, "She is deemed the right person to honor the citizens who defended the Constitution and democracy through the Light Revolution against insurrection, and to spread the status of K-democracy both domestically and internationally." ( 박 위원장에 대해서는 “시민사회단체연대회의 공동대표와 환경운동연합 전국공동대표를 역임하는 등 지난 30년간 시민사회와 민주주의 발전에 헌신해 온 시민운동가”라며 “내란에 맞선 빛의 혁명으로 헌법과 민주주의를 수호한 국민을 기리고, 케이(K)-민주주의의 위상을 국내외로 확산시킬 적임자로 판단했다”고 말했다.)

He further said, "Based on her deep understanding of civic democracy and communication skills, Chairperson Park is expected to further enhance the completeness of K-democracy, which the citizens have safeguarded, thereby supporting the people's sovereign government." ( 그러면서 “박 위원장이 시민민주주의에 대한 깊은 이해와 소통 능력을 바탕으로 국민이 지켜낸 케이(K)-민주주의의 완성도를 더욱 높여 국민주권정부를 뒷받침할 것으로 기대된다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Justice Party: "Only Kim Min-seok and Jeong Cheong-rae's battle of nerves remains; the essence of supplementary investigation rights has disappeared" (정의당 “김민석-정청래 신경전만 남고, 보완수사권 본질 사라져”)
item.description:
The Justice Party criticized the "supplementary investigation rights debate" unfolding within the Democratic Party of Korea, stating, "The essence of prosecution reform is gone, leaving only a battle of nerves between Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and former leader Jeong Cheong-rae. The priorities have been severely reversed." (정의당이 더불어민주당에서 벌어지고 있는 ‘보완수사권 논쟁’에 대해 “검찰개혁의 본질은 없고 김민석 국무총리와 정청래 전 대표의 신경전만 남았다. 본말이 심각하게 전도된 꼴”이라고 비판했다.)

In a statement issued on the 26th, the Justice Party said of the supplementary investigation rights debate within the Democratic Party, "It is highly inappropriate for the ruling party to handle issues directly related to citizens' criminal rights in this manner. If a nation's investigation system is determined by internal power struggles, battles of nerves, and political strife within a specific political party, it would be truly shameful and pathetic." (정의당은 26일 성명을 내어 민주당 내 보완수사권 논쟁에 대해 “집권여당이 시민의 형사적 권리와 직결되는 문제를 이런 식으로 다루는 것은 매우 부적절하다”며 “일국의 수사 체계가 특정 정당 내부의 권력 암투, 신경전, 정쟁으로 결정된다면 참으로 부끄럽고 한심한 일”이라고 했다.)

The Justice Party stated, "The essence of prosecution reform lies in protecting the criminal rights of citizens and victims, and it should not merely be about revenge against the prosecution. If supplementary investigation rights are necessary to prevent irreversible grievances for ordinary victims, then the role of politics is to derive alternatives that prevent such rights from being abused. For this reason, the Justice Party has argued for the limited and exceptional allowance of supplementary investigation rights." (정의당은 “검찰개혁의 본질은 시민과 피해자의 형사적 권리를 보호하는 데 있으며, 단지 검찰에 대한 복수에 그쳐선 안 된다”며 “평범한 피해자에게 돌이킬 수 없는 억울함을 안기지 않기 위해 보완수사권이 필요하다면, 보완수사권이 악용되지 않는 방향으로 대안을 도출해 내는 것이 정치의 역할이다. 정의당은 이러한 이유로 보완수사권의 제한적·예외적 허용이 필요하다고 주장해 왔다”고 말했다.)

The Justice Party said, "If a nation's investigation system to be operated for the criminal rights of citizens is determined by internal power struggles, battles of nerves, and political strife within a specific political party, it would be truly shameful and pathetic. The Democratic Party should stop unnecessary conflicts and strive to enhance citizens' rights, not to appeal to hardline supporters." (정의당은 “시민들의 형사적 권리를 위해 운용될 일국의 수사체계가 특정 정당 내부의 권력 암투, 신경전, 정쟁으로 결정된다면 참으로 부끄럽고 한심한 일일 것”이라며 “민주당은 불필요한 갈등을 중단하고 강성 지지층에 호소하기 위해서가 아니라 오직 시민의 권리를 증진하기 위해 노력하라”고 말했다.)

The following is the full text of the Justice Party's statement. (다음은 정의당 성명 전문.)

[Statement] The Democratic Party's political strife over supplementary investigation rights ahead of the party convention has reversed the priorities ([성명] 전당대회 앞둔 민주당의 보완수사권 정쟁, 본말이 전도됐다)

  ( )

The Democratic Party of Korea is engaging in political-level clashes over the issue of supplementary investigation rights for the prosecution service. The essence of prosecution reform has vanished, leaving only a battle of nerves between Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and former leader Jeong Cheong-rae. The priorities have been severely reversed. It is highly inappropriate for the ruling party to handle issues directly related to citizens' criminal rights in this manner. (더불어민주당에서 공소청 보완수사권 문제를 두고 정쟁 수준의 공방이 오가고 있다. 검찰개혁의 본질은 온데간데없고, 김민석 총리와 정청래 전 대표의 신경전만 남았다. 본말이 심각하게 전도된 꼴이다. 집권여당이 시민의 형사적 권리와 직결되는 문제를 이런 식으로 다루는 것은 매우 부적절하다.)

The reason Democratic Party figures are engaging in a battle of nerves over the supplementary investigation rights issue is that the party convention is approaching in August. With Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and former leader Jeong Cheong-rae expected to run for the party leadership, political clashes are unfolding between those seeking to highlight supplementary investigation rights as a key issue and those opposing it. (민주당 인사들이 보완수사권 문제에 대해 신경전을 벌이는 것은 오는 8월 전당대회를 앞두고 있기 때문이다. 김민석 총리와 정청래 전 대표가 당 대표직 경선을 치를 것으로 예상되는 상황에서, 보완수사권을 핵심 쟁점으로 부각시키려는 쪽과 그에 반대되는 쪽의 정치적 공방이 펼쳐지고 있는 것이다.)

The Justice Party sympathizes with the prosecution reform aimed at dismantling the power of the political prosecution. However, as we have stated on several occasions, the essence of prosecution reform lies in protecting the criminal rights of citizens and victims, and it should not merely be about revenge against the prosecution. (정의당은 정치검찰의 권력을 청산하는 검찰개혁에 공감한다. 하지만 여러 차례 입장을 밝혔듯 검찰개혁의 본질은 시민과 피해자의 형사적 권리를 보호하는 데 있으며, 단지 검찰에 대한 복수에 그쳐선 안 된다.)

The same applies to the question of whether to maintain or abolish supplementary investigation rights. This is not a matter to be judged with a dichotomous mindset that maintaining supplementary investigation rights is 'evil' and abolishing them is 'good.' If supplementary investigation rights are necessary to prevent irreversible grievances for ordinary victims, then the role of politics is to derive alternatives that prevent such rights from being abused. (보완수사권 존폐 여부도 마찬가지다. 보완수사권 유지는 ‘악’이고 폐지는 ‘선’이라는 이분법적 사고방식으로 판단할 문제가 아니다. 평범한 피해자에게 돌이킬 수 없는 억울함을 안기지 않기 위해 보완수사권이 필요하다면, 보완수사권이 악용되지 않는 방향으로 대안을 도출해 내는 것이 정치의 역할이다.)

For this reason, the Justice Party has argued for the limited and exceptional allowance of supplementary investigation rights. We propose allowing the prosecution service to conduct supplementary investigations directly or instruct the police to do so, limited to cases such as those with imminent statutes of limitations, cases where police investigations have been delayed for a long time after complaints or accusations, or cases where the nature of the incident suggests insufficient initial police investigation or suspicions of cover-up. This is essential to prevent the shifting of responsibility between agencies and to avoid unfavorable situations where procedural issues allow criminals to escape punishment. (정의당은 이러한 이유로 보완수사권의 제한적·예외적 허용이 필요하다고 주장해 왔다. 공소시효가 임박한 사건이나 고소·고발 후 장기간 경찰 수사가 지연되는 사건, 사건의 성격상 경찰의 초동 수사가 미진하거나 은폐 의혹이 있는 사건 등에 한해 공소청이 직접 보완수사를 하거나 경찰에 지시할 수 있도록 허용하자는 것이다. 기관 간의 책임 전가를 막고, 절차적 문제로 범죄자가 처벌을 면하는 불리한 상황을 방지하기 위해 절실한 일이다.)

If a nation's investigation system to be operated for the criminal rights of citizens is determined by internal power struggles, battles of nerves, and political strife within a specific political party, it would be truly shameful and pathetic. The Democratic Party should stop unnecessary conflicts. Strive to enhance citizens' rights, not to appeal to hardline supporters. We urge you to show the responsibility befitting a ruling party. (시민들의 형사적 권리를 위해 운용될 일국의 수사체계가 특정 정당 내부의 권력 암투, 신경전, 정쟁으로 결정된다면 참으로 부끄럽고 한심한 일일 것이다. 민주당은 불필요한 갈등을 중단하라. 강성 지지층에 호소하기 위해서가 아니라 오직 시민의 권리를 증진하기 위해 노력하라. 집권여당다운 책임감을 보일 것을 촉구한다.)

June 26, 2026 (2026년 6월26일)

Justice Party (정의당)

Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk names lawmakers who called for his resignation on YouTube: "Will take measures against such actions" (장동혁, 유튜브 나와 ‘사퇴 제기’ 의원 실명 저격…“해당 행위 조치”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, mentioned the real names of lawmakers who have called for his resignation as party leader, stating that necessary measures should be taken to prevent such actions from continuing. Following his mention of establishing "party discipline," he has increased pressure by specifying the targets. (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 자신을 향해 ‘대표직 사퇴론’을 제기한 의원들의 실명을 거론하며 더이상 해당 행위를 하지 못하도록 필요한 조치를 해야 한다고 밝혔다. 당의 ‘기강 확립’을 언급한 데 이어 구체적인 대상자들을 명시하며 압박 수위를 높이는 모습이다.)

Appearing on the Pen&Mic YouTube channel on the 26th, Rep. Jang stated, "I hope we can compile a list of those within the party who are voicing division and conflict." He added, "I would like to see a list of what they have done over the past year and during the local elections—whether they have used social media or appeared on broadcasts to fight the Democratic Party, or proposed policies or legislation." (장 대표는 26일 펜앤마이크 유튜브에 출연해 “당에서 분열과 갈등의 목소리를 내는 분들 명단을 작성해봤으면 좋겠다”며 “지난 1년과 지방선거 국면에서 그분들이 민주당과 싸우기 위해서 사회관계망서비스(SNS)를 하거나 방송에 출연해 이야기한 것, 정책을 내거나 법안을 발의한 것 목록을 작성해 봤으면 좋겠다”고 말했다.)

He then mentioned Reps. Kim Jae-seop, Kim Yong-tae, Woo Jae-joon, and the group "Alternatives and Future," saying, "It's astounding—when it's time to fight the enemy, they hide in the shadows, but when it comes to attacking the party leadership internally, they are the first to step forward and raise their voices the loudest." (그는 이어 김재섭, 김용태, 우재준 의원과 대안과미래를 거론하며 “기가 막히게 적과 싸워야 할 때는 뒤에 숨어 있다가 당내에서 지도부를 공격할 때는 맨 먼저 나와서 가장 목소리를 높인다”고 말했다.)

Targeting Rep. Song Seok-joon, Rep. Jang said, "This three-term lawmaker from Gyeonggi Province, who is calling for my resignation, lost the mayoral race. It was a mayor he himself nominated." Regarding Rep. Lee Seong-kwon, he added, "This two-term lawmaker from Busan lost the district office head position. It was a district office head he himself nominated." This appears to reference the loss of the Icheon mayoral seat in Gyeonggi Province and the Saha-gu district office head position in Busan to the Democratic Party in the June 3 local elections. He said, "Please look at the local election results in those areas. In areas where our party holds an advantage with our lawmakers, they should have achieved at least similar results compared to other lawmakers." (장 대표는 송석준 의원을 겨냥해 “제 사퇴를 주장하는 경기도 3선 의원은 시장을 뺏겼다. 본인이 공천한 시장”이라고 했다. 이성권 의원에 대해서도 “부산 재선 의원은 구청장을 뺏겼다. 본인이 공천한 구청장”이라고 말했다. 이는 지난 6·3 지방선거에서 경기 이천시장과 부산 사하구청장을 민주당에 내준 점을 거론한 것으로 보인다. 그는 “그 지역 지방선거 성적표를 봐달라”며 “우리 의원이 있는 우리 당 우세 지역에서는 다른 의원들과 비교했을 때 적어도 비슷한 성적은 가져왔어야 한다”고 말했다.)

Rep. Jang stated, "The beginning of conservative reconstruction is ensuring that those who do not fight when they should fight the enemy and instead focus only on internal party battles can actually fight the enemy. Taking necessary measures—according to the party constitution, party rules, principles, and standards—to continuously prevent lawmakers who engage in such actions from doing so, and thereby restoring party discipline, is the proper way for a political party and the path to conservative reconstruction." (장 대표는 “적과 싸워야 할 때 싸우지 않고 당내 싸움에만 몰두하는 분들이 적과 싸울 수 있게 하는 것이 보수 재건의 시작”이라며 “지속적으로 해당 행위를 하는 의원들에 대해서 더이상 해당 행위를 하지 못하도록 당헌·당규와 원칙과 기준에 따라 필요한 조치를 하는 것, 그래서 당의 기강을 바로 세우는 것이 올바른 정당의 모습이고 보수 재건의 모습”이라고 했다.)

Rep. Jang also sharpened his tone toward independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon. He said, "The person who provided the cause for the conservative party to reach this state now claims to be reconstructing conservatism, and is joining forces to attack and drive out the party leader. Correcting such things is establishing party discipline and the first step toward party renewal and conservative reconstruction." (장 대표는 한동훈 무소속 의원을 향해서도 날을 세웠다. 그는 “보수 정당이 이 지경에 오도록 원인을 제공했던 사람이 보수 재건을 하고, 그와 힘을 합쳐 당대표를 공격하고 내쫓겠다고 한다”며 “그런 것부터 바로잡는 것이 당 기강을 확립하는 것이고 당을 쇄신하는 보수 재건의 첫걸음”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "We must create new security innovation companies to compete with Palantir" (이 대통령 “팔란티어와 경쟁할 신안보 혁신 기업 만들어야”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 26th, "The government intends to foster new security innovation companies that possess cutting-edge monopoly technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI), drones, cybersecurity, and space aviation." (이재명 대통령이 26일 “정부는 인공지능(AI), 드론, 사이버 안보, 우주 항공 등 첨단 독점 기술을 보유하는 신안보 혁신 기업을 육성하려고 한다”고 말했다.)

At the "Future New Security Innovation Company Fostering Strategy Meeting" held at the Blue House, President Lee stated, "For the Republic of Korea to evolve from a traditional defense powerhouse into a global new security powerhouse, fostering new security innovation companies at the national level is of paramount importance." He added, "While not excluding large corporations, I believe it could be a new stage where innovation companies with advantages in speed and agility, such as venture startups, can play a leading role." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 ‘미래 신안보 혁신기업 육성 전략회의’에서 “대한민국이 전통적인 방산 강국에서 글로벌 신안보 강국으로 거듭나기 위해서는 국가적 차원의 신안보 혁신 기업 육성이 무엇보다 중요하다”며 “대기업을 배제하는 건 아니지만, 벤처 스타트업 등 속도나 민첩성 측면에서 우위에 있는 혁신 기업들이 주역으로 활동할 수 있는 새로운 무대가 아닌가 싶다”며 이같이 말했다.)

President Lee further emphasized, "We must also create innovation companies that can confidently compete with Palantir, a US company with an enterprise value of 480 trillion won, and Germany's Helsing, valued at 26 trillion won." Palantir provides public-sector AI services to US intelligence agencies and the military, while Helsing is a German defense AI drone startup. (그러면서 이 대통령은 “기업가치가 480조원에 이르는 미국의 팔란티어나 26조에 이르는 독일의 헬싱사와 당당히 경쟁할 수 있는 혁신 기업을 우리도 만들어야 한다”고 강조했다. 팔란티어는 미국 정보기관과 군 등에 공공기관용 인공지능 서비스를 제공하는 기업이고, 헬싱사는 독일의 국방 인공지능 드론 스타트업 기업이다.)

President Lee set a goal of fostering five companies with an enterprise value of over 1 trillion won and 50 companies with revenues of 100 million won in the new security sector by 2030. He said, "To achieve this, we will introduce an innovation-promoting contract system in non-defense fields like space aviation to enable rapid procurement of technology products from innovation companies." He added, "In the defense sector, since there is an existing arms procurement system, we plan to create a new 'advanced technology acquisition system' to enable the initial deployment of advanced weapons systems within one year." (이 대통령은 2030년까지 신안보 분야에서 기업 가치 1조원 이상 기업 5개, 매출 1억원 기업 50개를 육성하겠다는 목표를 제시했다. 이 대통령은 “이를 위해 혁신 기업의 기술제품을 신속 구매할 수 있도록 우주항공 같은 비국방 분야에서는 혁신 촉진형 계약제도를 도입하겠다”며 “국방 분야에서는 기존의 무기 도입 체제가 있기 때문에 1년 이내에 첨단 무기 체계 최초 배치가 가능하도록 ‘첨단 기술형 획득 제도’를 새로 만들려고 한다”고 말했다.)

President Lee also stated, "We will expand the government's strategic investment in the new security industry by establishing a Korean-style In-Q-Tel, similar to the US Central Intelligence Agency's (CIA) In-Q-Tel model, which strengthens security capabilities through investment in innovation companies and technology linkages." He also announced plans to support young talents entering new security innovation companies by designating universities as centers for new security startups. (이 대통령은 또 “혁신 기업 투자와 기술 연계 등으로 안보 역량을 강화한 미국의 중앙정보국(CIA)의 인큐텔 모델처럼 한국형 인큐텔 설립을 통해 신안보 산업에 대한 정부의 전략적 투자를 확대해 나가겠다”고 말했다. 아울러 신안보 창업 중심 대학 지정 등을 통해 젊은 인재들이 신안보 혁신기업에 진입할 수 있도록 지원하겠다고 밝혔다.)

In the United States, In-Q-Tel, a nonprofit venture capital firm founded by the CIA, operates entirely on government funding and invests in promising security technology companies in fields like AI and drones. 'Palantir' is a representative example of an In-Q-Tel investment. The government plans to reference this model to establish a system that supports strategic investment and technology commercialization for new security technologies domestically. (미국에서는 중앙정보국(CIA)이 설립한 비영리 벤처캐피탈인 인큐텔(In-Q-Tel)이 100% 정부 예산으로 운영되며, 인공지능(AI)·드론 등 유망 안보 기술기업에 투자한다. ‘팔란티어'가 대표적인 인큐텔의 투자 사례다. 정부는 이 같은 모델을 참고해 국내에서도 신안보 기술에 대한 전략적 투자와 기술 사업화를 지원하는 체계를 구축하겠다는 계획이다.)

item.title: Han Sung-sook criticized by People Power Party for cheap rent and sale: "Is this a roundabout gift?" (한성숙, 임대·매매 싸게 줬더니…국힘 “우회 증여냐” 비판)
item.description:
On the second day of the confirmation hearing for Prime Minister nominee Han Sung-sook on the 26th, the ruling and opposition parties clashed over allegations that she rented and sold an officetel to an acquaintance at below-market prices. <<> People Power Party lawmaker Kim Hee-jung questioned, "Did the nominee sell an officetel to an acquaintance at a bargain price? What kind of acquaintance would receive such special treatment, which even siblings would rarely get? Isn't this a roundabout gift?" Han reportedly sold one officetel for business use on the 12th of this month, after her nomination as Prime Minister, for 1.5 billion won, lower than the market price. The buyer was identified as Mr. A, the owner of a beauty salon in Cheongdam-dong, Gangnam-gu, to whom Han had leased the officetel for 24 months starting last April at below-market rent. <<> Kim further claimed that this salon owner had stated on social media that he styled the hair of former President Roh Moo-hyun's wife, Kwon Yang-sook, and added, "When I asked if he had ever been in charge of another first lady, he stopped contacting me." <<> In response, Democratic Party lawmaker Lee So-young retorted, "I'm ashamed of the level of this hearing. If the nominee had charged high rent, wouldn't you have criticized her as an exploitative landlord? Do we need to know who the tenant styled in the past when leasing an officetel? Are we wasting confirmation hearing time with such leaps and baseless speculation that even elementary school students wouldn't make?" <<> Han rebutted Kim's claims, saying, "It wasn't selling even after I kept lowering the price, but when he expressed interest, I offered to sell it to him. I don't understand how this can be framed as a gift or receiving some benefit." Han added, "Bringing up the first lady is unacceptable. These claims of unusual transactions or suspicious signs are overblown." <<> Reporter Koh Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (한성숙 국무총리 후보자 인사청문회 이틀째인 26일, 여·야는 한 후보자가 지인에게 시세보다 저렴하게 오피스텔을 임대·매매했다는 의혹을 두고 공방을 벌였다.)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon and Han Dong-hoon Unite to Criticize Semiconductor Cluster Project in Honam (오세훈·한동훈, 호남 반도체 클러스터 조성 사업 일제히 비판)
item.description:
<<> Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon and independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon on the 26th criticized the government's push to create a semiconductor cluster in the Gwangju/Jeonnam region in collaboration with Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, calling it a "tactical rampage" and "no different from the Park Geun-hye administration's Mir-K Sports Foundation case." <<> In a Facebook post on the same day, Mayor Oh stated, "The large-scale semiconductor investment in Honam led by the presidential office is a 'privatization of state affairs' that twists the arms of large corporations for vote calculations and infringes on the freedom of corporate activity." He further criticized, "Ignoring the industrial survival conditions—such as securing electricity, water, and talent—this is an irresponsible intervention aimed solely at rallying supporters for elections, thereby eroding national competitiveness." He added, "The tactical rampage only serves the hardcore base, and the consequences fall entirely on the people. President Lee Jae-myung must accurately read the sentiments from the last election." <<> Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon also posted on Facebook the same day, writing, "The Lee Jae-myung regime is summoning the heads of Samsung and SK one after another, pressuring them to build a semiconductor cluster in Honam. If the chairmen cave in to this coercion and agree, the government will claim that the companies 'voluntarily' decided to invest." He went on, "How is this any different from the Mir-K Sports Foundation case, which contributed to bringing down the Park Geun-hye administration, where companies claimed they 'voluntarily' donated money?" This draws a parallel between the semiconductor cluster project and the 2016 "Mir K-Sports Foundation case," which sparked the national corruption scandal amid suspicions that the Park Geun-hye government forced 77 billion won from about 30 large corporations, including Samsung. <<> He emphasized, "If the authorities pressure only the chairmen, who have much to fear and need from power, into deciding, should shareholders just follow along?" He added, "Considering the holdings of these two companies by the National Pension Service, such actions cause enormous harm to our people and future generations." He further noted, "According to the revised Commercial Act enacted by the Lee Jae-myung government, succumbing to political pressure and damaging shareholder value is illegal." He concluded, "If they use the hard-earned assets of 5 million shareholders as 'ammunition for the Myeong-Cheong (Lee Jae-myung and Jeong Cheong-rae) showdown,' the directors will face legal liability for breaching their duty of loyalty to shareholders." <<> Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr ()

item.title: "An Unforgivable Couple... Kim Keon Hee’s Bribery and Influence-Peddling While Yoon Suk Yeol Dreamed of Insurrection" (“용서받지 못할 부부…윤석열 내란 꿈꿀 때 김건희 매관매직”)
item.description:
First Lady Kim Keon Hee, accused of using her position to solicit favors and accept bribes totaling 300 million won, was sentenced to seven years in prison in the first trial, prompting political circles to denounce the couple as "unforgivable" and the verdict as "justice prevailing." (대통령 부인이라는 지위를 이용해 인사 청탁 등과 함께 3억원 상당의 금품을 수수한 혐의를 받는 김건희 여사가 1심에서 징역 7년을 선고받자 정치권에서는 “용서받지 못할 부부”, “사필귀정”이라는 반응이 나왔다.)

Park Ji-hye, spokesperson for the Democratic Party of Korea, stated in a briefing on the 26th, "The court’s decision to clearly acknowledge the quid-pro-quo relationships across the charges and deliver a stern legal judgment is a natural outcome. This ruling exposes how the high moral standards and integrity required of a president’s spouse were utterly devastated during the Yoon Suk Yeol administration." She added, "This is undeniably the epitome of influence-peddling leveraging power. Kim Keon Hee’s actions cannot be dismissed as mere indiscretion; they are grave corruption crimes that have undermined the nation’s personnel system and fairness." ( 박지혜 더불어민주당 대변인은 26일 브리핑에서 “공소사실 전반에 걸쳐 대가관계를 명백히 인정하고 준엄한 법의 심판을 내린 사법부의 판단은 당연한 결과”라며 “이번 판결을 통해 윤석열 정권 기간 대통령 배우자에게 요구되는 높은 도덕성과 청렴성이 얼마나 처참히 실종되었는지 드러났다”고 밝혔다. 박 대변인은 “권력을 배경으로 삼은 매관매직의 결정판이라 하지 않을 수 없다”며 “김건희의 매관매직은 처신이 경솔했다는 영혼 없는 변명으로 덮을 수 있는 수준이 아니다. 국가 인사 시스템과 공정성을 무너뜨린 중대 부패 범죄의 죄과가 가볍지 않다”고 덧붙였다.  )

Democratic Party lawmaker Han Min-soo wrote on Facebook, "The woman who claimed nothing was wrong saw every single item she received tied to a favor. While her husband Yoon Suk Yeol dreamed of insurrection and ruined the country with tyranny, his wife Kim Keon Hee took bribes and sold public office. This is a truly unforgivable couple." (한민수 민주당 의원은 이 페이스북 글에서 “아무것도 아니라던 사람이 받은 것 하나하나 청탁의 대가가 아닌 게 없다“며 “남편 윤석열이 내란을 꿈꾸며 폭정으로 나라를 망치고 있을 때 부인 김건희는 뇌물을 받고 공직을 팔고 있었다. 결코 용서받지 못할 부부”라고 비판했다.)

Another Democratic Party lawmaker, Park Ju-min, also posted on Facebook, "This is the worst case of state affairs being exploited through the trading of unearned power. Accept the price for dragging South Korea backwards—take it willingly." (박주민 더불어민주당 의원도 이날 페이스북에서 “위임받은 적도 없는 권력을 거래한 최악의 국정농단”이라며 “대한민국을 한참 뒤로 후퇴시킨 죗값, 달게 받으십시오”라고 말했다.)

Hwang Jung-ah, a Democratic Party lawmaker, wrote on Facebook, "Yoon Suk Yeol’s regime’s ‘de facto ruler’ Kim Keon Hee gets seven years in prison. The punishment for privatizing public authority above the president and peddling influence in exchange for jewelry and luxury goods has finally been handed down." (황정아 민주당 의원은 이날 페이스북에서 “윤석열 정권의 상왕 김건희 징역 7년 선고”라며 “대통령 위에서 공적 권한을 사유화하며, 귀금속과 명품을 대가로 매관매직을 일삼은 죗값이 드디어 내려졌다”고 말했다.)

The Rebuilding Korea Party, in a statement by spokesperson Lim Myeong-hee, said, "This ruling officially confirms through the judiciary that the long-held rumor—'If you get Kim Keon Hee on your side, everything works out'—was true." It added, "The social cost South Korea has borne from Kim’s ‘presidential playacting’ is immense. Kim Keon Hee must now humbly accept the court’s stern judgment and offer profound repentance and apology to the nation." ( 조국혁신당은 이날 임명희 대변인 명의 논평에서 “이번 판결은 공공연하게 떠돌던 ‘김건희만 통하면 다 된다’는 통설이 사실이었음을 사법부를 통해 공식 인증된 것”이라고 밝혔다. 그러면서 “김건희씨의 대통령 놀이에 대한민국이 감당한 사회적 손실이 너무 크다”며 “김건희씨는 이제라도 사법부의 엄중한 심판을 겸허히 받아들이고, 국민 앞에 뼈저리게 반성하고 사죄하라”고 덧붙였다.)

The party particularly emphasized, "The court stated this was a crime that could have led to life imprisonment if the accused were a public official. Even though she is not a civil servant, the judiciary has sternly warned that her abuse of the immense influence of a president’s spouse to meddle in state affairs is as grave as crimes warranting a life sentence." ( 특히 조국혁신당은 “재판부가 ‘공무원 신분이었다면 최고 무기징역까지 가능한 범죄’임을 명시했다”며 “비록 공무원은 아닐지라도, 대통령 배우자라는 막강한 영향력을 사유화해 국정을 농단한 죄질이 무기징역에 비견될 만큼 무겁다는 점을 사법부가 엄중히 경고한 것”이라고 강조했다.  )

Son Sol, senior spokesperson for the Progressive Party, said in a written briefing, calling the ruling "a stern judgment on influence-peddling corruption" and "justice prevailing." She noted, "The court criticized Kim for ‘accepting items that ordinary people could never acquire in a lifetime without hesitation. The pathetic excuses from Kim’s side, calling them ‘inauguration gifts’ or ‘purchasing agents,’ have been completely rejected." ( 손솔 진보당 수석대변인은 이날 서면브리핑에서 이번 판결을 “매관매직 비리에 대한 엄중한 심판”이자 “사필귀정”이라고 말했다. 손 대변인은 “재판부는 김건희가 ‘일반인은 평생 취득하기 어려운 물품들을 거리낌없이 수수했다’고 질타했다”며 “‘취임 축하 선물’, ‘구매 대행’이라던 김건희 쪽의 구차한 변명은 완전히 배격되었다”고 했다.)

She added, "Her arrogant attitude of denying the charges without remorse throughout the trial has been reflected in the heavy sentence. The court has clearly proven that there are no sacred cows before the law and that severe accountability follows actions that destroy public trust for private gain." (손 대변인은 “재판 과정 내내 반성 없이 혐의를 부인해 온 오만한 태도 역시 중형 선고에 그대로 반영되었다”며 “법원 역시 법 앞에 성역이 없음을, 그리고 사익을 위해 공적 신뢰를 무너뜨린 행위에는 엄중한 책임이 따른다는 점을 명백히 증명했다”고 덧붙였다.)

The Seoul Central District Court’s Criminal Division 21 (presided over by Judge Jo Sun-pyo) held the first trial sentencing for Kim’s violations of the Act on Aggravated Punishment of Specific Crimes (bribery mediation) at 2 p.m. that day, convicting her on all charges and sentencing her to seven years in prison. (서울중앙지법 형사21부(재판장 조순표)는 이날 오후 2시 김 여사의 특정범죄가중처벌법 알선수재 혐의 1심 선고기일을 열고 혐의를 모두 유죄로 인정해 징역 7년을 선고했다.)

Kim is accused of accepting bribes in exchange for providing public positions or business deals, including a Dior bag from Pastor Choi Jae-young, a Van Cleef & Arpels necklace worth 103.8 million won from Seohee Construction Chairman Lee Bong-kwan, a 39.9 million won Bausch & Lomb Constellation watch from robot dog business operator Seo Seong-bin, a 2.65 million won gold turtle and Sehando painting from former National Education Committee Chairman Lee Bae-yong, and a 140 million won painting by artist Lee Woo-hwan from former senior prosecutor Kim Sang-min. (김 여사는 △최재영 목사가 건넨 디올 가방 △이봉관 서희건설 회장에게서 받은 반클리프아펠 목걸이 등 1억380만원짜리 귀금속 △로봇개 사업자 서성빈씨에게서 받은 3990만원짜리 바슈롱 콩스탕탱 시계 △이배용 전 국가교육위원장에게서 받은 265만원짜리 금거북이 및 세한도 △김상민 전 부장검사에게서 받은 1억4천만원짜리 이우환 화백 그림을 공직 및 사업권 제공 청탁과 함께 수수한 혐의를 받는다.)

Reporter Lee Yoo-jin yjlee@hani.co.kr (이유진 기자 yjlee@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae "Kim Min-seok Proposed Handling of Prosecution Reform Bill in May? I Don't Recall That" (정청래 “김민석이 검찰개혁안 5월에 처리 제안? 그런 기억 없다”)
item.description:
Former Representative Jung Cheong-rae stated on the 26th regarding Prime Minister Kim Min-seok's claim that he proposed handling the "second prosecution reform bill" in May to the party, saying, "I don't recall that." The two appear to be locked in a war of truth over the proposal for the "second prosecution reform bill to be handled in May." (정청래 전 대표가 26일 ‘2차 검찰개혁안을 5월에 처리하자고 당에 제안했다’는 김민석 국무총리 발언에 대해 “그런 기억이 없다”고 말했다. ‘2차 검찰개혁안 5월 처리 제안’을 두고 두 사람이 진실공방을 벌이는 모양새다.)

After attending the "June 3 Local Election Female Candidates Winners' Convention" held at Bloomvista Hotel in Yangpyeong, Gyeonggi Province, on that day, former Representative Jung responded to reporters' questions about Prime Minister Kim's remarks, stating, "I don't recall that" and adding, "I asked floor leader Han Byeong-do yesterday (the 25th), but there was nothing clear about it." Representative Jung added, "Until now, from our party's perspective, I only understood it as 'The government will draft a proposal, so wait.'" (정 전 대표는 이날 경기 양평 블룸비스타 호텔에서 열린 ‘6·3 지방선거 여성 당선자 대회’에 참석한 뒤 김 총리의 발언에 대한 입장을 묻은 취재진의 물음에 “저는 그런 기억이 없다”며 “어제(25일) 한병도 원내대표한테 물어봤는데 뚜렷하게 뭐가 있는 건 아니더라”라고 말했다. 정 대표는 “지금까지 저희 당의 입장에서는 ‘정부에서 안을 만들 테니 기다려라’ 저는 그렇게만 알고 있었다”고 덧붙였다.)

The previous day, Prime Minister Kim announced that he would not submit the government's prosecution reform bill related to the supplementary investigation authority to the National Assembly, saying, "I judged it desirable to expedite the handling of the second reform bill earlier than originally agreed upon by the party and government, so I proposed handling it in May to the party, but due to the party's rejection, it was postponed." However, former Representative Jung denied this, saying he had "no memory" of it. (전날 김 총리는 검찰수사보완권 관련 검찰개혁 정부안을 국회에 제출하지 않겠다는 발표를 하면서 “2차 개혁안을 애초 당정 합의보다 시간을 당겨서 조속히 처리하는 것이 바람직하겠다는 판단이 들어 5월에 처리하려고 당에 제안했으나 당의 거부로 이를 연기했다”고 말했다. 그런데 정 전 대표는 “기억이 없다”며 이를 부인한 것이다.)

Furthermore, former Representative Jung said, "I understood that if the government submits a proposal to the National Assembly, it would be discussed there, but with the sudden announcement that it wouldn't be submitted to the National Assembly, there was a proposal prepared by lawmakers and civil society, so I said I would co-sponsor it," adding, "Since there's a ready proposal, I think we need to discuss it quickly and pass it through the National Assembly plenary session with a sense of urgency." (정 전 대표는 아울러 “정부 안을 국회에 제출하면 그걸 가지고 국회에서 논의하는 것으로 알고 있었는데, 갑작스럽게 국회 제출을 안 한다고 하니 국회의원들과 시민사회 쪽에서 준비했던 안이 있어 저도 공동발의하겠다고 했다”며 “준비된 안이 있으니 빠르게 논의를 해서 속도감 있게 국회 본회의 통과를 해야 할 것 같다”고 했다.)

item.title: Cho Tae-yul speaks with Iranian foreign minister… "Emphasizes safe passage of ships in the Strait of Hormuz" (조현, 이란 외교장관과 통화…“호르무즈 선박 안전 통항 강조”)
item.description:
Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul discussed the situation in the Middle East, bilateral relations, ship passage in the Strait of Hormuz, and protection of overseas nationals during a phone call with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi on the 26th. This was the fifth phone call between the two ministers since the outbreak of war between the U.S. and Iran in late February. (조현 외교부 장관이 압바스 아라그치 이란 외무장관과 26일 통화에서 중동 정세와 양국 관계, 호르무즈해협 내 선박 통항, 재외국민 보호 등에 대해 논의했다. 두 장관의 통화는 지난 2월 말 미국과 이란 간 전쟁 발발 이래 5번째다.)

During the call, Minister Cho told Minister Araghchi, "I welcome the conclusion of the U.S.-Iran memorandum of understanding on ending the war and the efforts of the parties involved, and I look forward to thorough implementation of the agreement and the conclusion of additional negotiations," the foreign ministry said. Minister Cho also emphasized the free and safe passage of ships in the Strait of Hormuz. Minister Araghchi explained the current status of negotiations with the U.S. and Iran's position. (조 장관은 이날 아라그치 장관과 통화에서 “미국-이란 간 종전 양해각서 협상 타결과 당사국들의 노력을 환영하며 철저한 합의 이행과 추가 협상 타결을 기대한다”고 말했다고 외교부는 밝혔다. 조 장관은 또한 호르무즈해협 내 선박의 자유롭고 안전한 통항을 강조했다. 아라그치 장관은 현재 미국과의 협상 관련 상황과 이란의 입장을 설명했다.)

The two ministers discussed pending issues in South Korea-Iran relations and agreed to continue communication regarding the safety of ships and crew, and the protection of overseas nationals, the foreign ministry reported. As eight South Korean ships that had been stranded in the Strait of Hormuz additionally exited the strait on this day, five South Korean ships and 47 South Korean crew members remain in the strait. (두 장관은 한-이란 관계 현안에 대해 논의하고, 선박·선원의 안전, 재외국민 보호 등과 관련해 계속 소통해 나가기로 했다고 외교부가 전했다. 호르무즈해협에 발이 묶였던 한국 선박 8척이 이날 추가로 해협을 빠져나오면서 해협에는 현재 한국 선박 5척, 한국 선원 47명이 남아 있다.)

It is believed that the two ministers exchanged views on Iran's reconstruction issues during the call. (이날 통화에서는 두 장관이 이란 재건 사안에 대해 의견을 교환했을 것으로 보인다.)

Minister Cho told reporters on the 22nd, "To participate in post-war recovery projects in the Middle East for our companies and to prepare comprehensive and holistic economic cooperation plans with the Middle East, we established a Korea-Middle East Comprehensive Economic Cooperation Team within the foreign ministry and have been actively identifying tailored cooperation needs with Middle Eastern countries through overseas diplomatic missions." (조 장관은 지난 22일 기자들에게 “전후 우리 기업의 대중동 피해 복구 참여와 중동과의 포괄적이고 종합적인 경제협력 방안을 마련하기 위해 외교부 내에 한-중동 포괄적 경제협력팀을 설치하고 재외공관을 통해 중동 각국과 맞춤형 협력 수요를 적극 발굴해왔다”고 밝힌 바 있다.)

item.title: Former Judicial System Secretary Lee Jin-guk Nominated as New Audit Commissioner (이진국 전 사법제도비서관 신임 감사위원에 임명 제청)
item.description:
Audit Monitor General Kim Ho-cheol on the 26th nominated Lee Jin-guk, a professor at Ajou University Law School and former Blue House secretary for judicial system, as the new audit commissioner. (김호철 감사원장이 26일 신임 감사위원에 청와대 사법제도비서관을 지낸 이진국 아주대 법학전문대학원 교수를 임명 제청했다.)

Professor Lee succeeds former audit commissioner Lee Nam-gu, whose term expired in April. The audit commissioner is a vice-minister-level public official appointed by the president upon nomination by the Audit Monitor General, with a term of four years. (이 교수는 지난 4월 임기가 만료된 이남구 전 감사위원의 후임이다. 감사위원은 감사원장의 제청으로 대통령이 임명하는 차관급 공직자다. 임기는 4년이다.)

Professor Lee served as the Blue House secretary for judicial system from June of last year to February of this year. Born in Goseong, South Gyeongsang Province, he earned a doctorate in law from the University of Marburg in Germany and later served as a research fellow and head of the Planning and Coordination Office at the Korean Institute of Criminology from 2002 to 2007. (이 교수는 지난해 6월부터 올해 2월까지 청와대 사법제도비서관으로 근무했다. 경남 고성 출신으로 독일 마부르크대학교에서 법학 박사학위를 취득한 후 2002년부터 2007년까지는 한국형사정책연구원에서 연구위원과 기획조정본부장 등을 지냈다.)

The Board of Audit and Inspection stated, "Since 2007 and up to the present in 2026, Professor Lee has been a professor of law at Ajou University, contributing to the development of national judicial administration with a focus on procedural legitimacy and human rights protection through various public sector activities, including serving as an expert committee member for the Ministry of Justice's Legislative Special Committee on the Punishment of Minor Offenses Act, an evaluation committee member for judicial reform at the Office for Government Policy Coordination, and president of the Korean Association of Criminal Law." The board added, "He is expected to play a key role in creating a 'human rights-friendly audit' environment and enhancing the objectivity of audit results, based on his firm convictions regarding human rights protection, expertise in criminal affairs, and diverse experience." (감사원은 “이 교수가 2007년부터 2026년 현재까지 아주대 법학 교수로 재직하면서 법무부 질서위반법 제정특위 전문위원, 국무조정실 사법개혁 평가위원, 한국형사법학회 회장 등 다양한 공공분야 활동을 통해 절차적 정당성과 인권보호에 중점을 둔 국가 사법행정 발전에 기여했다”고 전했다. 감사원은 “인권 보호에 관한 확고한 소신과 형사 분야에 대한 전문성·다양한 경험 등을 바탕으로 ‘인권친화적 감사’ 환경을 조성하고, 감사결과의 객관성을 높이는 데 중요한 역할을 할 것으로 기대된다”고 덧붙였다.)

By Kwon Hyuk-cheol, Reporter nura@hani.co.kr (권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)
